BIRTHDAY PARTY (AGES 8 - 17)

Are you ready to throw an epic birthday party that's a cut above the rest? Look no further than Skeggy's Axe House & Arcade! Our **Platinum Package** is the ultimate ticket to a bash that's both ax-cellent and arcade-tastic!

 

**Axe Throwing Adventure** (1 Hour 15 Minutes):

Unleash your inner Viking! Our expert instructors will give you 15 minutes of top-notch guidance before you start hurling axes like a pro and be with your group throughout the stay to essure saftey and facilitate fun games for all. It's the perfect way to kick off the celebrations with a bang - or should we say, a 'thunk'?

 

**Unlimited Arcade Mania** (1 Hour):

Ready to zap, smash, and score your way into arcade glory? Dive into an hour of unrestricted access to our mind-blowing collection of arcade games. Whether you're a skee ball wizard or a Pac-Man enthusiast, there's something for everyone!

 

**Pizza & Cake Time** (45 Mins):

Whether you want to bring your own cake or order some pizzas, our venue is ready to accommodate your celebration needs. And hey, no need to worry about those pesky crumbs - we've got it all covered!

 

**Special Gift for the Guest of Honor**:

It's your day, so you deserve an extra slice of awesome! We've got a special surprise gift just for you, because what's a birthday without a little mystery and excitement?

 

**Party Like a VIP**:

With our dedicated party professional at your service, you'll feel like royalty! They'll handle everything - from setting the scene with plates and napkins to serving up the feast and managing the post-party cleanup. You just focus on having fun!

 

**Unlimited Fountain Drinks**:

Keep the spirits high and the throats quenched with our endless fountain of drinks. Whether you're a cola connoisseur or a lemonade lover, we've got your back!

 

At Skeggy's, we promise a birthday bash that's not just another year older, but a legendary story to tell. So, are you ready to join the ranks of the most epic party throwers? Let's make some unforgettable memories at Skeggy's Axe House & Arcade!

Get ready to amp up the excitement for your next birthday party with Skeggy's Axe House & Arcade's **Gold Package**! This is where fun meets adventure, with just the right sprinkle of competition and arcade magic.

 

**Axe-ceptional Fun** (1 Hour 15 Minutes):

Begin your birthday bonanza with an hour of thrilling axe throwing! Our skilled instructors will spend 15 minutes showing you the ropes, ensuring you're ready to hit bullseyes and impress your friends. You're in for a real treat!

 

**Arcade Game Galore** (30 Mins):

Half an hour of non-stop arcade action awaits! Jump into a whirlwind of classic and contemporary games. Get ready to unleash your inner gamer and set some high scores!

 

**Pizza & Cake Celebration** (45 Mins):

Whether you want to bring your own cake or order some pizzas, our venue is ready to accommodate your celebration needs. Enjoy 45 minutes of delicious eating, laughing, and making merry. It's the perfect time to gather around, share stories, and savor every bite of your special day.

 

**Bring on the Bash**:

With our Gold Package, the focus is on fun and games! While there's no dedicated party professional, our friendly staff will ensure your experience is seamless and joyous. You'll have everything you need for a great time, just bring your party spirit!

 

**Refresh and Recharge**:

Stay refreshed with our available drinks. While this package doesn't include unlimited fountain drinks, our selection of beverages is sure to keep the party vibe going.

 

Celebrate your special day at Skeggy's Axe House & Arcade, where every throw is a chance to make a memory and every game is an opportunity to shine. Grab your friends, step into the arena of fun, and let's make this birthday one for the history books with our Gold Birthday Bash Bonanza!

Get set for a thrilling birthday celebration with Skeggy's Axe House's **Silver Package**! Tailored for the axe-throwing, this package is a direct hit for a fun-filled and unique birthday experience.

**Axe-Throwing Adventure** (1 Hour 15 Minutes):

Step into the exciting world of axe throwing for a full hour of pure exhilaration! Our skilled instructors will provide 15 minutes of expert guidance to get you started before your hour begins. Then, it's all about fun and friendly competition as you and your guests take aim and throw. Get ready to unleash your inner warrior and aim for those bullseyes!


**Time for Treats** (45 Minutes): While our Silver Package focuses on the axe-throwing fun, you're welcome to add on some food and drinks to your party and bring your cake to celebrate. Whether you want to bring your own cake or order some pizzas, our venue is ready to accommodate your celebration needs.

At Skeggy's Axe House, we believe in delivering an unforgettable experience. With our Silver Package, you're not just throwing axes; you're throwing a party that everyone will remember. So grab your friends, step up to the throwing line, and let's celebrate your special day with an axe-throwing extravaganza like no other!

Get set for a thrilling birthday celebration with Skeggy's Axe House's **Arcade Only Package**! This package is a direct hit for a fun-filled arcade birthday experience for those ages 8 and older.

**Unlimited Arcade Mania** (1 Hour 15 Minutes):

Ready to zap, smash, and score your way into arcade glory? Dive into an hour and fifteen minutes of unrestricted access to our mind-blowing collection of arcade games. Whether you're a skee ball wizard or a Pac-Man enthusiast, there's something for everyone!


**Time for Treats** (45 Minutes): While our Silver Package focuses on the axe-throwing fun, you're welcome to add on some food and drinks to your party and bring your cake to celebrate. Whether you want to bring your own cake or order some pizzas, our venue is ready to accommodate your celebration needs.

At Skeggy's Axe House, we believe in delivering an unforgettable experience. So grab your friends and let's celebrate your special day with an party like no other!
